d:
"Daydreaming" is taken from Anoushka Shankar's new mini-album, "Chapter I: Forever, For Now". It is an interpretation of a traditional Carnatic lullaby and was recorded at LEITER Studio in Berlin's celebrated Funkhaus complex, and features acclaimed pianist Nils Frahm.
Composed by Anoushka Shankar
Produced by Arooj Aftab
Arranged by Anoushka Shankar & Nils Frahm
Sitar: Anoushka Shankar
Piano: Nils Frahm
Co-Producer: Saloni Thakkar
Recording Engineer: Antonio Pulli
